fixes.name: the Dardanelles
fixes.note: The strait is 1.2 km at its narrowest and the raster resolves 0.37 km per pixel, so the south-west mouth blurs shut and the Sea of Marmara is unreachable by sea. Herodotus has fleets pass it repeatedly; Xerxes bridges it at 7.36.

note: White is water. Every skin reads this, not its own pixels.
